en: Changed plugin MCP bundles (`.mcpb`, `.dxt`) to unpack under the plugins directory, not `.mcpb-cache` in the plugin's folder, so read-only plugin folders load; one fetched by URL downloads again once
zh: 变更 plugin MCP 包（`.mcpb`、`.dxt`）：改为解压到 plugins 目录下，而非 plugin 文件夹中的 `.mcpb-cache`，使只读 plugin 文件夹也能加载；通过 URL 获取的包会重新下载一次
